script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2.
Let list2 be [].
Return _ → map with (_ → range with (arg2), given () { If util → sum with (list2) is 0, then set list2 to _ → map with (arg1, given () { Return 1. }). Let v be util → lot with (list2, given (arg) { Return arg. }, {returnIndex: true}). Decrease list2 at v by one. Return arg1 at v. }).

script_hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "jecht_shot" on the enemy.
Let number be the numeric entry "jecht_shot_count" in aiArg.
Let v be the items member in the living party where member → is-possible-to-target.
Let list2 be [].
If v is not empty, then set list2 to call helper with (v, number).
Let list3 be [].
For each x in _ → range with (number)
  If x is 0, then append {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: {activeTarget: list2 at x}} to list3.
  Otherwise, append {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: {activeTarget: list2 at x, skipMessage: true, skipStepCnt: true}} to list3.
The enemy uses ability with its cast time and then list3.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be this state → retrieve-register-ability-conf with (arg).
Let ability be this state → get-ability-id-from-conf with (arg, v).
If ability is the id of the move labelled "jecht_shot" on executer, then helper2 → call with (arg).
Otherwise, executer uses ability with options v's 'abilityOptions'.
